_comment: Issue #660 (ADR-103): an item counted in pieces with a box of 10 and a carton of 24, both for buying and selling, whose box unit's usual pack is 50 metres for selling. RetailUnitsIT.aUsualPackOfAnotherUnitIsNotPromoted asserts the live /products/{id} packs and /retail/stock row equal this file; transfer-packs.dom.test.tsx feeds it to Move stock. So the payload the PWA is tested with is the one the server sends. Fabricated units and quantities.
